technical_failure: The required black HotCore proof is visually blank, so the four-proof gate is incomplete.
The same role appearing only on neutral gray proves that the current dark/emission/alpha setup is not robust for the required black gameplay background.
visual_rejection_reasons: HotCoreForkedLick reads as several smooth opaque ribbon bands forming an eye/loop, not a compact volumetric flame with a dominant hot core and secondary fork.
DarkRedOpenOverturnFold is effectively a constant-width C-shaped arc with nested bands, directly matching the prohibited generic arc/ring language.
Both roles use broad flat color bands with hard boundaries; the inner-to-mid-to-outer transition lacks soft luminous depth, controlled falloff and flame-like overlap.
The silhouettes are too mathematically smooth and evenly spaced, with no deliberate bulbous root, swelling shoulder, unequal fork, tapered tongue or authored terminal breakup.
The gray proofs show some mesh depth but the visible design is still dominated by flat front-facing bands and does not meet the supplied school-example or commercial quality floor.
r10_requirements: Keep exactly two roles and four future proofs; do not expand to the full effect.
HotCoreForkedLick must be one bulbous tapered closed flame volume with a bright central tongue and one shorter unequal fork fused at the root, not crossing ribbon loops.

DarkRedOpenOverturnFold must be one thick hooked teardrop mass with a swollen shoulder, clear open notch and rapidly tapered overturn tip; it must not have constant sweep width or concentric arc bands.
Use three nested closed volumes with visibly different silhouettes and depth, not three uniformly offset copies.
Use a black-background-safe luminous material stack: white-yellow inner, orange/red mid, restrained soft dark-red outer falloff, with explicit black and gray pixel gates.
Author one or two clean asymmetric surface breakups in the gradient/alpha, avoiding random grain, dirty fringe, cards or detached beads.
The next offline audit must include 3Q, side-depth and silhouette diagnostics before requesting an Editor slot.
